{
  "version": 1,
  "source_benchmark_id": "4a9653c8e4b28ccd9a68e0c9f2b35cd1a6a6d3fe0b664670bdb6ecdd44f18be8",
  "strategy": "Organize fixed contracts by semantic providers: state and object access, capability and thread primitives, architecture operations, then composed invocations and kernel entry. Keep independent branches separate and import only reusable generated correspondence facts. Preserve every original context; unproved oops slots provide no facts.",
  "modules": [
    {
      "name": "Vero_CorresCombinators",
      "contracts": [
        "c0035",
        "c0038",
        "c0039",
        "c0107",
        "c0215",
        "c0181"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "General correspondence combinators for spec_corres, conditional errors, ignored reads, zipped monadic iteration and the syscall exception pipeline. These are fixed polymorphic contracts, not new helper declarations. Independent of kernel operation proofs; consumers may instantiate completed c0035/c0038, c0039, c0215 and c0181 locally."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_StateFields",
      "contracts": [
        "c0031",
        "c0032",
        "c0150",
        "c0144",
        "c0149",
        "c0152",
        "c0081",
        "c0194",
        "c0206",
        "c0162",
        "c0156"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "State-relation projections and updates for current/idle threads, domain, domain time and scheduler action. Put direct curDomain c0150 before its equivalent c0144 and conditional c0149. Supplies cheap shared reads and writes without importing the full scheduler."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_HeapObjects",
      "contracts": [
        "c0131",
        "c0127",
        "c0128",
        "c0129",
        "c0130"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "Generic non-TCB object update c0131 precedes endpoint and notification setters; getters use the corresponding object relations. These are the heap primitives needed by IPC and notification lifecycle operations, independent of message transfer and scheduling."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_ThreadObjects",
      "contracts": [
        "c0192",
        "c0204",
        "c0205",
        "c0213",
        "c0189",
        "c0208",
        "c0209",
        "c0151",
        "c0195",
        "c0190",
        "c0202",
        "c0214",
        "c0243"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "TCB read/update and extended-TCB relations, followed by field projections and runnable tests. Raw object results c0192/c0204 support c0205/c0213 and asUser consumers. Keep setThreadState out because its concrete definition invokes rescheduleRequired; this branch contains only object-level access."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_CapReads",
      "contracts": [
        "c0036",
        "c0044",
        "c0045",
        "c0196"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_ThreadObjects"
      ],
      "rationale": "Relate get_cap to getCTE first, then getSlotCap and the TCB embedded-capability projections. Reuse c0192/c0213 where useful for TCB reads. c0036 and c0044 provide slot reads for both CSpace traversal and mutation, despite originating in different owner theories."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_CapLookup",
      "contracts": [
        "c0048",
        "c0047",
        "c0046",
        "c0058",
        "c0057",
        "c0114"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads"
      ],
      "rationale": "Address-bit resolution c0048 precedes thread-slot lookup c0047, capability lookup c0046 and its c0058 reformulation, CNode-operation lookup c0057, and paired cap/slot lookup c0114. All use cap reads; no mutation, IPC transfer or invocation imports are needed."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_CapDerivation",
      "contracts": [
        "c0001",
        "c0043",
        "c0055",
        "c0056"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads"
      ],
      "rationale": "Architecture derive-cap is a small case analysis provider for generic deriveCap c0055; ensureNoChildren c0043 precedes it. ensureEmptySlot uses slot reads. This isolates capability validation used by decoders and transfers from insertion and deletion."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_UntypedIndices",
      "contracts": [
        "c0049",
        "c0050",
        "c0253",
        "c0254"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads"
      ],
      "rationale": "Untyped capability field updates: raw setCTE c0049 supports marking a parent full c0050; updateCap for untyped caps c0253 and updateFreeIndex c0254 expose reusable index updates. Keep these below insertion, reset and ASID-pool creation, not behind the whole untyped invocation."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_CapInsertion",
      "contracts": [
        "c0041",
        "c0053",
        "c0052",
        "c0059"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_UntypedIndices"
      ],
      "rationale": "General cteInsert c0041 uses cap reads and setUntypedCapAsFull c0050; derive the simple-cap specialization c0053 afterward. Reply-master construction c0052 precedes setupReplyMaster c0059. Supplies insertion and reply setup without importing finalisation."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_CapMovement",
      "contracts": [
        "c0054",
        "c0042",
        "c0040"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads"
      ],
      "rationale": "Capability move and swap preserve capability/MDB relations. cteSwap c0042 precedes capSwapForDelete c0040. They can use object/slot access and sanitized move definitions, independently of recursive deletion and invocation dispatch."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_UserRegisters",
      "contracts": [
        "c0184",
        "c0185",
        "c0186",
        "c0187",
        "c0096",
        "c0097",
        "c0218",
        "c0219",
        "c0105",
        "c0282",
        "c0267"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_ThreadObjects"
      ],
      "rationale": "General asUser c0184 precedes invariant-strengthened c0185 and register/PC instances. Message-info get/set and VM-fault register handling reuse those instances. Grouping crosses TCB, IPC and VSpace owners but shares the same user-context relation and avoids full VSpace imports."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_UserMemory",
      "contracts": [
        "c0198",
        "c0197",
        "c0113",
        "c0210"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "Machine/user-memory word correspondence c0198 supports offset load c0197 and its argument-rewritten form c0113; c0210 handles stores. These are buffer-access providers independent of IPC protocols and capability operations."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_MessageBuffers",
      "contracts": [
        "c0199",
        "c0200",
        "c0191",
        "c0203",
        "c0188",
        "c0112"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads",
        "Vero_UserRegisters",
        "Vero_UserMemory"
      ],
      "rationale": "IPC-buffer lookup general c0199 precedes its invariant wrapper c0200. getMRs, setMRs, copyMRs and loadCapTransfer compose register and user-word access. Consumers receive message transport primitives without endpoint protocol or invocation dependencies."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_ReadyQueues",
      "contracts": [
        "c0183",
        "c0182",
        "c0193",
        "c0211",
        "c0212",
        "c0165",
        "c0201",
        "c0157",
        "c0155",
        "c0160"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_StateFields",
        "Vero_ThreadObjects"
      ],
      "rationale": "Bitmap no-op c0183 precedes conditional c0182; queue access and dequeue/enqueue/append precede rescheduleRequired c0201 and possibleSwitchTo c0157, matching their definitions. Priority and fast-fail queries remain here. Provides scheduling mutations without importing address-space switching or the complete schedule proof."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_ThreadState",
      "contracts": [
        "c0207"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_ReadyQueues"
      ],
      "rationale": "setThreadState updates the TCB, tests runnable/current thread/action, and may call rescheduleRequired. Import the queue/action providers before proving c0207; IPC cancellation and activation can use it without depending on complete scheduling."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_NotificationBindings",
      "contracts": [
        "c0072",
        "c0073",
        "c0220"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_HeapObjects",
        "Vero_ThreadObjects"
      ],
      "rationale": "Unbind notification from either side and bindNotification use notification objects plus bound-notification TCB fields c0190/c0202. No cancellation or finaliseCap import is required. These operations feed finalisation and TCB notification invocation."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_IpcCancellation",
      "contracts": [
        "c0091",
        "c0094",
        "c0092",
        "c0095",
        "c0093"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_HeapObjects",
        "Vero_ThreadState"
      ],
      "rationale": "Blocked endpoint cancellation and cancelSignal use endpoint/notification setters and setThreadState. Batch cancellation and badged-send cancellation additionally use ready queues and rescheduleRequired. All are below finalisation; full cancelIPC and suspend, which are not fixed contracts, may be handled locally using these facts."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_IrqPrimitives",
      "contracts": [
        "c0074",
        "c0076",
        "c0084",
        "c0087",
        "c0080",
        "c0089",
        "c0078",
        "c0075"
      ],
      "imports": [],
      "rationale": "IRQ-slot/state operations, activity and range tests, trigger machine operation, architecture handler case and preemption point. getIRQState c0084 precedes isIRQActive c0087. This independent branch supplies finalisation, untyped reset and IRQ decoding without importing interrupt handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_FinaliseSlot",
      "contracts": [
        "c0069",
        "c0070",
        "c0064",
        "c0062",
        "c0065",
        "c0071",
        "c0066"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_CapReads",
        "Vero_IrqPrimitives"
      ],
      "rationale": "Final-capability query c0069 precedes its conditional-result wrapper c0070. No-op untyped index clearing and architecture/IRQ post-deletion precede generic postCapDeletion c0071 and emptySlot c0066. These slot-cleanup facts are usable before general finaliseCap and recursive deletion."
    },
    {
      "name": "Vero_FastDelete",
      "contracts": [
        "c0067",
        "c0063"
      ],
      "imports": [
        "Vero_FinaliseSlot",
        "Vero_NotificationBindings",
        "Vero_IpcCancellation"
      ],
      "rationale": "Prove restricted fast_finaliseCap c0067 directly from can_fast_finalise cases, notification unbinding and IPC cancellation, then cap_delete_one c0063 using finality and emptySlot. Deliberately precedes general finaliseCap: this breaks the apparent cancelIPC/suspend/finaliseCap cycle and supplies reply-cap deletion for restart and IPC."
    }
  ],
  "execution_order": [
    "Vero_CorresCombinators",
    "Vero_StateFields",
    "Vero_HeapObjects",
    "Vero_ThreadObjects",
    "Vero_CapReads",
    "Vero_CapLookup",
    "Vero_CapDerivation",
    "Vero_UntypedIndices",
    "Vero_CapInsertion",
    "Vero_CapMovement",
    "Vero_UserRegisters",
    "Vero_UserMemory",
    "Vero_MessageBuffers",
    "Vero_ReadyQueues",
    "Vero_ThreadState",
    "Vero_NotificationBindings",
    "Vero_IpcCancellation",
    "Vero_IrqPrimitives",
    "Vero_FinaliseSlot",
    "Vero_FastDelete"
  ]
}
